description: U_PDUs from different clients waiting for the same transmission go on air highest priority first, and in arrival order within a priority, whichever client sent them.
note: Three clients bind for non-ARQ: conn 1 SAP 5, conn 2 SAP 6, conn 3 SAP 7. At 0, in that order, each sends one U_PDU to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (TTD 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091): conn 1 'low-a' at priority 2, conn 2 'high' at priority 9, conn 3 'low-b' at priority 2 (A-0062, A-0063: 15 highest). The first starts dts.ttd and the MAC's first LBT wait (lbt_wait_dcd_ms); csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes the contention wait 0 (K-0080), so the node transmits at the LBT expiry. Higher-priority queued U_PDUs take precedence over lower ones (A-0064), and within a priority the older goes first (C-0853), whichever client sent them: the transmission carries 'high', then 'low-a', then 'low-b', with C_PDU IDs 0, 1, 2 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040). Each D_PDU is type 7 (C-0575), EOW 0, address size 3, source 0.0.1.2, the whole DATA C_PDU (the DATA S_PDU with its priority, source and destination SAPs and TTD, B-0297) as one segment; all in block 0 of a one-block burst of 5550 ms, so EOT and reception window are ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). The queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled first (C-1050).
